Definition: to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree
BiblicalUsage: Pâ'ar is to glorify, to beautify, to make splendid. God glorifies Himself in Israel His servant, He beautifies the place of His sanctuary, His people become the branch of His planting and the work of His hands that He may be glorified, and He beautifies the meek with salvation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's glory is not decoration added to His people; it is what He makes them. He takes His own and makes them beautiful so that the beauty points back to Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
